caption: We came back on 16 November 2026, 26 days after our test. On our unpaid account the same agent took two shop questions and only replied: This assistant can't reply right now.
While we set up the agent, Chatwith put the Guardrails level on Max by default and says that level is hard to customise or override.
From our short list of shop facts the chat built quick reply buttons for Product, Color, Pickup and Warranty.
